svg.title: About — Strong design, practical engineering, real results.
svg.desc: I’m a freelance developer and creative technologist. I build websites and mobile experiences, use AI to automate useful work and make video, and connect the finished product to digital marketing. Services: web development, mobile apps, AI automation, AI video, digital marketing.
